title.narrative: Anti-Corruption for Trust in Lebanon

description.narrative: The overall objective of the Anti-Corruption for Trust in Lebanon Project is to enable the adoption and measurable progress in preventing and combating corruption through four outputs: 1. Capacity to oversee and monitor national anti-corruption strategy institutionalized and supported, 2. Specialized anti-corruption legislations enacted and supported for effective implementation, 3. National Anti-Corruption Institution operationalized and strengthened, 4. Corruption risk management mechanisms integrated in key vulnerable sectors.
